name: komdosh-dev-arch-planner
description: Creates a definitive whole-service implementation agentic plan for one backend service, sourced from the company architecture repository (ADR sets, per-service architecture packages, domain top-level docs, business scope/roadmaps, dev-ex standards). /implementation-plan <service> resolves the architecture repo (flag → .claude/architecture.yaml → well-known paths → code-RAG MCP), assembles a tiered evidence inventory, defers to the architecture repo's own plan-service-implementation contract when present, verifies current implementation state via graph/RAG MCP when available, and writes docs/plans/<date>-<service>-implementation-plan.md — ordered agent todos with priority, inputs, write scope, acceptance criteria, verification, dependencies, each mapped to the marketplace agent or command that executes it. Requires komdosh-dev-spring-core.
